author: michaelkrymski
summary: Audit portrait preview mapping and isolate optional target inspection from live depth
details: Add rendered marker mapping tests and synthetic target confidence/percentile counterexamples. Add local per-patch depth distributions and exact sector crop diagnostics. After operator reported crash/black preview/WSS cycling, disable inspection to restore streaming, then move inspection to a bounded utility queue at most once per second and rate-limit local probe writes. Production thresholds, shared dependencies and drift configuration unchanged. Local work only; no GitHub operations or motor controls.
validation: Signed physical iPhone build and strict signature passed. Ten PreviewState tests (including three rendered mapping cases) and two synthetic target processor tests passed. No matching device crash report found; cause unconfirmed. Restored no-inspection run had 523 sends (517 all-three numeric); corrected inspection run initially had 66 sends with live portrait camera and local clock guard passing. Final observation recorded in dedicated handoff/evidence. Physical chair causation remains unverified.
